description: LmdbBlockDb::open uses a PathGuard RAII struct to ensure OPEN_PATHS is consistent even if open, write_txn, or commit fails midway. PathGuard::defuse() is called only after Ok(Self{...}) is reached. This correctly prevents the common bug where a process-global registry becomes permanently inconsistent after a partial construction failure. The pattern is well-documented and the test 'failed_open_does_not_lock_open_paths' validates it.
title: good: lmdb PathGuard RAII pattern correctly handles mid-construction errors
